attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single high-definition 2D prop sprite for the French Mass Effect — Relay Chronicles Armax art bible. One complete chair, one static view, actual transparent alpha.
Primary request: reproduce the Illusive Man's specific ME2 chair from these inspected visual references as an EMPTY CHAIR. Preserve its recognizable geometry, silver metal structure, dark seat and dark back surfaces; this is a faithful reference-led game-art reconstruction, not a new futuristic chair design.
Input images: Image 1 is a primary ME2 press screenshot from December 2009, authoritative for the game's visible chair silhouette and materials. Image 2 is an official BioWare licensed statue photographed from the front three-quarter, used only to reveal chair supports obscured in the screenshot. Image 3 is the same official statue from the rear three-quarter, used only to understand the open frame and central back support. The statue's tiled display base, the person and every background are excluded.
Subject details: a low, restrained lounge/briefing chair with a thin dark upholstered seat in a rectangular silver rim; a restrained curved dark back on a broad silver central spine and a short broad top crosspiece; narrow horizontal silver armrests with thin dark pads, supported by curved open metal arms. Preserve the distinctive paired sweeping flat silver side frames and long horizontal runners at floor level, with open diagonal support geometry. The frame is flattened brushed/polished metal, not round office-chair tubing. Accurately preserve proportions and the negative spaces shown in the reference images. If an armrest inset is visible in the reference, keep it small and dark. Do not add invented mechanisms.
Style/medium: detailed adult-proportion HD game sprite, realistic painted/PBR-like finish, crisp readable silhouette and restrained texture, consistent with a polished 2D character cutout in a 3D RPG. Not pixel art, not chibi, not a miniature-toy photo.
Composition/framing: front three-quarter view matching Image 2, chair facing slightly toward image right; mild elevation and very low perspective distortion. Full chair including all runner ends, metal supports, armrests and top backrest visible, centered on a portrait canvas with generous transparent margin on all sides. One chair only. No turnaround or multi-panel sheet.
Lighting/materials: neutral soft studio lighting so the dark upholstery and silver/chrome frame remain legible; retain their source colors, no orange star reflection, no cyan repaint. Controlled highlights, clear structural edges.
Scene/backdrop: completely transparent alpha, including every opening between supports. No floor, no shadow plane, no room, no star, no pedestal and no display-base tiles.
Constraints: EMPTY chair, no character or anatomy, no cigarette floating in space, no props, no logos, no text or watermark, no wheels, no office pedestal, no gaming-chair headrest, no thick padded throne, no dramatic effects, no motion.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: a single additional fixed-pose HD 2D character sprite for the ME2 Illusive Man in the Mass Effect — Relay Chronicles Armax art bible, transparent alpha.
Primary request: add the adult Illusive Man from Mass Effect 2 SEATED IN THE EXACT EMPTY CHAIR OF IMAGE 1. Preserve that chair's frame shape, runner geometry, armrests, seat, backrest, materials, camera and relative proportions. The body can naturally occlude the chair, but visible parts must continue the same forms. This is one calm seated narrative-support pose, not an animation sheet.
Input images and hierarchy: Image 1 is the empty chair edit target and geometry/lighting continuity reference. Image 2 is the primary ME2 press screenshot, the authority for the character's period, costume and in-game seated setting. Image 3 is the historical Troodon model sheet, used for the ME2 costume cut, gray rectangular open-neck plastron, sleeve accents, short dark hair and adult proportions, not as evidence for the chair. Image 4 is the project's existing generated lot13 standing sprite: match its adult HD finish, face/costume continuity and scale language, while keeping the ME2 references authoritative. Image 5 is an official BioWare licensed statue from the front three-quarter: use its readable crossed-leg resting pose and body-chair contacts, not its miniature surface finish or tiled base.
Character: one middle-aged adult human man, short combed-back dark hair with gray temples, clean-shaven angular face, restrained stern expression, small pale blue cybernetic irises without beams or bright eye bloom. Black tailored ME2 suit and trousers, gray/light-silver raised open collar and vertically ribbed rectangular chest insert, light cuff details, black formal shoes. No ME3 facial implants, scars or indoctrination changes.
Observed pose target: lean calmly back into the chair, pelvis firmly on the seat, right ankle resting over left knee, left foot fully visible and lowered to the chair's support plane. The right forearm rests naturally along the near armrest with the hand draped over its end; the left elbow is supported near the far armrest and the left hand is raised comfortably beside the shoulder, holding one small cigarette between two fingers. Fingers must be anatomically readable and relaxed. Both shoes, both hands, all visible chair supports and runner ends remain inside the frame.
Composition: use Image 1's front three-quarter view facing slightly toward image right, low perspective distortion and coherent anatomy. Keep the same chair geometry rather than redesigning it to fit the figure. Full seated adult figure and entire chair on a portrait canvas, centered, with comfortable transparent margins above hair, beside elbows/raised hand, and below the shoes and runner ends. Do not crop or duplicate any limb.
Style and lighting: polished realistic painted/PBR-like 2D game sprite consistent with Image 4, neutral soft studio light and clear silhouette. Preserve black cloth, gray collar and silver metal. Detailed face, hands and cloth folds; no statue-toy texture, pixel art or chibi proportions.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent alpha including the open spaces between arms and chair supports. No room, no star, no floor or shadow plane, no display plinth or tiles, no logos, labels, watermark or UI. No smoke cloud, motion trails or effects.
